---
description: "On-time figures for each Island Transit route and each timetable stop, from saved bus locations."
title: "Routes"
subtitle: "On time, route by route and stop by stop"
---

Pick a route on the map or from the list to see how its buses did.
We count departures only at the stops whose times are printed in Island
Transit's timetables, called
[timepoints]{.term tabindex="0" tip="The stops whose times are printed in Island Transit's timetables. These are the times the agency publishes for riders."},
because those are the times riders are promised. A bus is
[on time]{.term tabindex="0" tip="A bus is on time if it leaves from 1 minute early to 5 minutes late. At the last stop of a trip, its arrival counts instead."}
if it leaves from 1 minute early to 5 minutes late.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import {json, pct, count, band, BANDS, NO_BAND, routeTitle, routeSub, routeOrder, routeSlug, lateness, plural, longDate, routeMap, dateAxis, MIN_OBSERVED, DATA_URL} from "./lib.js"
import {drawRouteMap} from "./map.js"
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
recent = json("data/ontime/recent.json")
mapData = routeMap(recent?.timepoints)
routeList = mapData == null ? [] : mapData.routes
  .map(r => ({...r, stats: recent?.routes?.[r.route_id] ?? null}))
  .sort(routeOrder)
byId = Object.fromEntries(routeList.map(r => [r.route_id, r]))
fromHash = {
  const h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)).toLowerCase();
  const r = routeList.find(r => routeSlug(r, r.route_id) === h);
  return r ? r.route_id : null;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const onHash = () => {
    const h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)).toLowerCase();
    const r = routeList.find(r => routeSlug(r, r.route_id) === h);
    const id = r ? r.route_id : null;
    const sel = viewof routeId;
    if (sel.value !== id) {
      sel.value = id;
      sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    }
  };
  addEventListener("hashchange", onHash);
  invalidation.then(() => removeEventListener("hashchange", onHash));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
bandTag = (b) => html`<span class="band-tag band-${b.key}"><span class="swatch band-${b.key}"></span>${b.label}</span>`

overview = () => {
  const rows = routeList.map(r => {
    const s = r.stats;
    return {
      route: r.route_id,
      name: routeTitle(r),
      where: routeSub(r),
      on_time: s?.on_time_share_of_observed ?? null,
      typical: s?.deviation_s_median ?? null,
      seen: s?.observed ?? 0,
      band: band(s?.on_time_share_of_observed, s?.observed),
    };
  });
  return html`<h2>All routes</h2>
    <p class="note">We don't rate a route until we've seen at least ${MIN_OBSERVED} of its departures.</p>
    ${Inputs.table(rows, {select: false,
      columns: ["name", "where", "on_time", "typical", "seen", "band"],
      header: {name: "Route", where: "Serves", on_time: "On time", typical: "Typical departure", seen: "Departures seen", band: "Band"},
      format: {on_time: d => pct(d), typical: d => lateness(d), seen: count, band: b => bandTag(b)},
      sort: "seen", reverse: true, rows: rows.length + 1, height: 34 * (rows.length + 1) + 8, layout: "auto",
    })}`;
}

detail = (r, s) => {
  if (s == null) return html`<h2>${routeTitle(r)}</h2><p>${routeSub(r)}</p>
    <p class="empty">None of this route's timepoint departures were scheduled during this period.</p>`;
  const b = band(s.on_time_share_of_observed, s.observed);
  return html`<h2 class="route-title">${routeTitle(r)} <span class="route-sub">${routeSub(r)}</span></h2>
  <div class="stat-row">
    <div class="stat stat-big"><div class="label">Departures on time</div>
      <div class="value">${pct(s.on_time_share_of_observed)}</div>
      <div class="note">${bandTag(b)}</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Typical departure</div>
      <div class="value">${lateness(s.deviation_s_median)}</div>
      <div class="note">Half of departures fell between ${lateness(s.deviation_s_p25)} and ${lateness(s.deviation_s_p75)}.</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Departures seen</div>
      <div class="value">${count(s.observed)} of ${count(s.scheduled)}</div>
      <div class="note">We couldn't put a time on the others, most often because of a gap in the bus's tracking.</div></div>
  </div>
  ${stopChart(s)}
  ${trendChart(s)}`;
}

stopChart = (s) => {
  const stops = s.stops.filter(d => d.deviations_counted > 0).map(d => ({
    ...d, label: d.name, med: d.deviation_s_median / 60, lo: d.deviation_s_p25 / 60, hi: d.deviation_s_p75 / 60,
    band: band(d.on_time_share_of_observed, d.observed)}));
  if (stops.length === 0) return html`<p class="empty">No stop on this route has enough departures yet.</p>`;
  const xmin = Math.min(-2, ...stops.map(d => d.lo)) - 0.5;
  const xmax = Math.max(8, ...stops.map(d => d.hi)) + 0.5;
  const ids = stops.map(d => d.stop_id);
  const names = Object.fromEntries(stops.map(d => [d.stop_id, d.label]));
  return html`<h3>Stop by stop</h3>
  <p class="note">Each dot shows the typical departure at that stop, and the gray bar covers the middle half of all departures there. Anything inside the shaded band counts as on time.</p>
  ${(() => {
    // On narrow screens, stop names go above each row instead of beside it.
    const narrow = width < 640;
    const rowH = narrow ? 46 : 34;
    return Plot.plot({
      ariaLabel: "Typical departure at each timepoint stop, in minutes late",
      ariaDescription: stops.map(d => `${d.label}: ${lateness(d.deviation_s_median)}`).join("; "),
      style: {background: "transparent", fontSize: "13px"},
      width: Math.max(320, Math.min(width, 960)),
      marginLeft: narrow ? 12 : 240, marginRight: 16, marginTop: narrow ? 26 : 10, marginBottom: 44,
      height: rowH * stops.length + 60,
      x: {domain: [xmin, xmax], grid: true, label: "Minutes late (negative: early)", labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 36},
      y: {domain: ids, tickFormat: id => names[id], label: null, axis: narrow ? null : "left"},
      marks: [
        Plot.rectX([0], {x1: -1, x2: 5, fill: "var(--status-good)", fillOpacity: 0.12}),
        Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "var(--text-muted)"}),
        Plot.ruleY(stops, {y: "stop_id", x1: "lo", x2: "hi", stroke: "var(--text-muted)", strokeWidth: 3, strokeLinecap: "round"}),
        Plot.dot(stops, {y: "stop_id", x: "med", r: 6, fill: d => d.band.color, stroke: "var(--surface)", strokeWidth: 2}),
        narrow ? Plot.text(stops, {y: "stop_id", x: xmin, text: "label", textAnchor: "start", dy: -15, fill: "currentColor"}) : null,
        Plot.tip(stops, Plot.pointerY({y: "stop_id", x: "med",
          title: d => `${d.label}\nTypically ${lateness(d.deviation_s_median)}\n${pct(d.on_time_share_of_observed)} on time (${plural(d.observed, "departure")} seen)`})),
      ],
    });
  })()}
  <details><summary>Stop table</summary>
  ${Inputs.table(stops, {select: false,
    columns: ["label", "on_time_share_of_observed", "deviation_s_median", "observed", "scheduled"],
    header: {label: "Stop", on_time_share_of_observed: "On time", deviation_s_median: "Typical departure", observed: "Seen", scheduled: "Scheduled"},
    format: {on_time_share_of_observed: d => pct(d), deviation_s_median: d => lateness(d), observed: count, scheduled: count},
    sort: null, rows: stops.length + 1, height: 34 * (stops.length + 1) + 8, layout: "auto"})}
  </details>`;
}

trendChart = (s) => {
  const days = s.daily.filter(d => d.on_time_share_of_observed != null)
    .map(d => ({...d, date: new Date(`${d.service_date}T12:00:00Z`)}));
  if (days.length < 2) return html`<h3>Day by day</h3><p class="empty">A day-by-day line will appear once there are two days of data.</p>`;
  return html`<h3>Day by day</h3>${Plot.plot({
    ariaLabel: "Share of this route's departures on time, by service day",
    ariaDescription: `From ${longDate(days[0].service_date)} to ${longDate(days.at(-1).service_date)}.`,
    style: {background: "transparent", fontSize: "13px"},
    width: Math.max(320, Math.min(width, 960)),
    height: 220, marginLeft: 50, marginRight: 30,
    ...dateAxis(days.map(d => d.date), 8, Math.max(320, Math.min(width, 960))),
    y: {domain: [0, 1], grid: true, label: "On time", tickFormat: d => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.lineY(days, {x: "date", y: "on_time_share_of_observed", stroke: "var(--series-1)", strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.dot(days, {x: "date", y: "on_time_share_of_observed", fill: "var(--series-1)", r: 4}),
      Plot.tip(days, Plot.pointerX({x: "date", y: "on_time_share_of_observed",
        title: d => `${longDate(d.service_date)}\n${pct(d.on_time_share_of_observed)} on time\n${pct(d.observed_share)} of departures seen`})),
    ],
  })}`;
}
```
